learning_outcomes.text: Know which standards must be considered for creating technical drawings.
Can apply these standards to create complete and standard-compliant graphical representations of designs.
Can apply the various projection methods.
Know which tolerances exist and can apply this knowledge correctly.
Can apply their knowledge about the representation of various machine elements in technical drawings.
Can develop new components and assemblies and design them for manufacturing, linking their knowledge.

syllabus_topics: Projection methods for the graphical representation of technical products
Sectional views, broken-out sections, views, details
Geometric Product Specification (GPS) according to ISO
ISO tolerance system, surface specifications, geometric tolerances, tolerance calculation
Typical machine elements and standard parts and their graphical representation
Design guidelines for various manufacturing processes
